programme.title: ESPN DOC. Looking for Maradona
programme.desc: November 25, 2025 will mark exactly five years since Diego Armando Maradona died. The Argentinian single-handedly guided his country to the world title in 1986 and took the then small Napoli by the hand on the way to two Italian national titles in the late 1980s. programme.desc: The French, as befits world runners-up, ended the group stage with complete victories. In the round of 16, they will face Sweden, which advanced to this stage as one of the third-placed teams. The Three Crowns players, who have won only one match so far, will have to stop Ousmane Dembélé and Kylian Mbappé. The Tricolor stars are fighting for the crown of the top scorer. So far, they have four goals each

programme.desc: In Arlington, Ivory Coast and Norway will play for promotion to the top sixteen. Both teams took second place in their groups with six points. Erling Haaland watched the entire match from the perspective of the substitutes' bench

programme.desc: The famous Estadio Azteca is the arena of the clash between Mexico and Ecuador. The World Cup co-hosts are one of three teams to have won all their matches in the group stage. However, they cannot underestimate their rival who was able to defeat the German national team. The winner of this match can play against England in the next round

programme.desc: The program includes the most important events from the World Cup arenas, analyzes and comments on past matches. Journalists and experts will also announce upcoming matches, present the lineups and tactics of individual teams... football magazine

programme.title: Football: World Cup 2026 – round of 16 match: England – Democratic Republic of Congo
programme.desc: The Democratic Republic of Congo has already made history by reaching the knockout stages of the World Cup for only the first time. She achieved this even though she had only a point before the last round. In the 1/16 finals, it will face a top-class opponent - England, which won Group E. However, in a draw with Portugal, the Leopards showed that they are not afraid of such challenges

programme.title: Football: World Cup 2026 – Round of 16 match: Belgium – Senegal
programme.desc: The winner of Group G and the third team in Group I will face each other at Seattle Stadium. Before the start of the World Cup, the Belgians would have been considered favorites in this match, but now it is no longer so obvious. In the previous round of the tournament, the Red Devils did not show anything that would confirm their status. They won only one of three matches against not-so-strong rivals. It remains to be seen whether this was just a smokescreen before the knockout stage or a real picture of the current capabilities of Kevin De Bruyne and company. To beat Senegal, Rudi Garcia's team must show much better football than in the group clashes with Egypt, Iran and New Zealand. The Teranga Lions have already shown at this World Cup that they have huge potential. If they release him in the match against the Belgians, we may see them in the 1/8 finals

programme.title: Football: World Cup 2026 – round of 16 match: USA – Bosnia and Herzegovina
programme.desc: The Americans, co-hosts of the World Cup, finished the competition in Group D in first place with eight goals scored. After victories over Paraguay 4-1 and Australia 2-0, they were euphoric. They were brought down to earth by the Turks, defeating them 3-2 in the last round of the regular phase of the tournament. That match, however, did not have much significance for the standings of Group D, and coach Mauricio Pochettino spared his biggest stars, including Christian Pulisic. The Milan player should therefore enter the fight for advancement to the 1/8 finals rested. This is not good news for the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team. However, players from the Balkans are not worried about this. For them, advancing to the knockout phase of the World Cup is already a success. They will take to the field at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium without pressure. This, however, will weigh on their rivals. Can the Yankees handle it?

programme.desc: A decent start of the season by Bruk-Bet Termalika Nieciecza must please the Słoniks' fans. The Ekstraklasa newcomer is at the top and can approach the match against Raków Częstochowa without any reservations, who still cannot stabilize their form.

programme.desc: Pogoń fans have been wondering for several weeks whether Efthymios Koulouris will leave their beloved team. The prolonged transfer saga involving the Greek striker does not have a positive impact on either the player himself or the team, which did not start the season well anyway. In three matches, she scored only four points, including a 1-5 defeat with Radomiak. Zabrze will try to take advantage of the confusion in the Port's camp to win in Szczecin for the first time since December 2023

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Lech Poznań – Korona Kielce

programme.title: I was the king – Grzegorz Lato | S01E02
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Grzegorz Lato won the top scorer's crown twice in the colors of Stal Mielec in the then 1st league, in 1973 and 1975. He was also the top scorer in the 1974 World Cup. After finishing his football career, he became a coach and later the president of the Polish Football Association (2008-2012). Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: I was a king - Lucjan Brychczy
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Lucjan Brychczy is a true legend of Legia Warsaw. He was a man deeply experienced in life. For a child harmed by the war, football was a way to survive in difficult times. He was associated with the capital club from 1954 until his death in 2024. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Big Brother Oasis | E01
programme.desc: A nature series devoted to the world's first artificial waterhole and the animals that use it. It was created in a reserve in Tanzania, an area of ​​the African savannah with poor water resources. It is not only an excellent vantage point for hidden cameras, but also a place of respite for wild animals such as lions, baboons, elephants, giraffes and buffalos. Thanks to hidden cameras, scientists want to track the secret behaviors of creatures gathering around the waterhole. They are wondering, among other things: whether half-year changes affect their customs and how predators and their prey coexist on a daily basis. For creatures such as lions, baboons, elephants, giraffes and buffalos, the waterhole is a place of respite. It is a field of observation for scientists. Researchers are wondering how predators and potential prey coexist. Great Britain, USA. 2020. nature series

programme.title: Lycaons: herd vs. rest of the world 2 – Return to South Luangwa | S02E01
programme.desc: Filmmaker and documentarian Julz Braatvedt again visits the charming areas of South Luangwa National Park in Zambia. He observes the everyday life and habits of three herds of wild wild lions and their interactions with other representatives of the local fauna. Viewers will see how the Kakumbi, Manzi and Kakula teams cope with the challenges of Zambian nature. Viewers will once again see wild lions living in South Luangwa National Park. They meet the Manzi puppies and the fearless little Kakumbi herd. Viewers will witness how one-year-old Snowy must stand up to the hyena. They will also observe lions trying to disperse the Wekl cubs. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Wimbledon (T2026): TBC
programme.desc: «The league of... (S1): Balls, head and heart» In the 90s, football imposed a model of masculinity based on testosterone and balls; Whoever does not follow it is considered a faggot, the star insult in stadiums that smell like cigars. Women are invisible because they are also invisible in other areas of society and are even prohibited from entering the boxes. Yes, they are present on television, but always as an object woman. In this context, Teresa Rivero becomes the first president of a professional club 'She was a pioneer' Rivero had no idea about football and it was her husband who put her there, but under her presidency Rayo Vallecano lived glorious days and created its women's section. Today, in a society that is improving in the face of machismo and homophobia, female presidents continue to be news, and no footballer in the history of La Liga has yet come out of the closet.

programme.title: The league of extraordinary men: Cojones, head and heart
programme.desc: «Dakar: race against the desert» For decades, the Dakar Rally has been much more than a race: it is the ultimate test of endurance, skill and passion in the world of motorsport. This documentary offers unprecedented access to the heart of Dakar 2023, accompanying the protagonists on a 9,000-kilometer, 14-day journey through the most extreme and challenging landscapes of the desert.

programme.title: Dakar: race against the desert
programme.desc: «Morata: they don't know who I am» 2024 was a roller coaster for Álvaro Morata in which the Madrid striker was, more than ever, at the center of everyone's attention. As captain of the Spanish team he won the European Championship, while in his private life he faced the breakup with his wife, Alice Campello. Now, Morata and its surroundings open the doors to everything that we did not see and did not know

programme.title: Morata: they don't know who I am
programme.desc: «Txiki Begiristain: farewell» After 13 years as Manchester City's director of football, Txiki Begiristain left his position in July. "Txiki Begiristain: the farewell" reviews his career and pays tribute to one of the key figures in consolidating the club into the elite of world football

programme.title: Little Beguiristain: farewell
programme.desc: «Bakalá (25/26): Ep.25» A program that combines current sports with the best of the house's archive. We tell you everything that happened during the week, while remembering mythical images. All of this enlivened with the voice of Raúl Pérez and his characters

programme.title: Bakalá (S25/26): Episode 25
programme.desc: «The league of... (T1): All the president's ultras» The presidents attend, astonished, the appearance in Spain of the ultra fans movement. They don't really know how to relate to them, but they are clear that they don't want them against them. To keep them happy, they give them privileges; After all, presidents are the first fans. Joan Gaspart, former president of the F.C. Barcelona boasts of being one of the Boixos Nois, the ultras of Barça. At the same time, their egos invite them to challenge each other, with cocky attitudes that begin with mockery and end in punches. These presidential attitudes are reproduced in the stadiums: dirty play, insults to the referee and racist chants are the order of the day. In this spiral of violence, the ultras cross the red line with physical attacks that end with the murder of Aitor Zabaleta. This death will mark a turning point, and the presidents will have to decide whether to protect or confront this monster that they themselves fed.

programme.title: The league of extraordinary men: All the president's ultras
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Pride, Courage and Claw: 100 years of Real Oviedo» On March 26, 2026, Real Oviedo turns one hundred years old. And he does it in the First Division, after a long journey of 24 years in which he came close to disappearing. From Isidro Lángara to Santi Cazorla, there are many players who have left their mark wearing the Real Oviedo shirt. A century of life with many small and great stories that deserve to be remembered and celebrated. And with a protagonist above all: the fans. The one who never abandoned her people in the years of mud and today celebrates with "pride, courage and determination" the centenary of her team

programme.title: Plus+ Report. Pride, Courage and Claw: 100 years of Real Oviedo
programme.desc: "The last duel" The 2026 World Cup could be the last one in which Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi meet. With this backdrop, this documentary takes a journey to the origin of the rivalry that starred modern football and turned LaLiga into a global phenomenon.

programme.title: The last duel
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Faustino Reyes. The Price of Silver» He was the protagonist of one of the most iconic photos of the 1992 Barcelona Olympic Games. A 17-year-old boy with a marked eye next to the King of Spain who surprised everyone by winning an unexpected silver medal. And after success came bad decisions, a life hooked on drugs and oblivion. About to turn 50, that money now returns to his life in the form of a new and last opportunity

programme.title: Plus+ Report. Faustino Reyes. The price of Silver
programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Craviotto» After the bronze achieved at the Paris Olympics, Saúl Cravioto became the most successful Spanish Olympic medalist in history with six metals to which must be added his four World titles and three European titles. Having just turned 40, the canoeist and national police officer speeds up his last strokes, looking back to review a path that has made him a sporting legend.

programme.title: Informe Plus+. Craviotto
programme.desc: «The Others (4): Bomb Transfers» That signing that was going to change the history of the club and did nothing. That other one from whom you didn't expect anything and confirmed the expectation. Very expensive signings with unprofessional lives or intrastories of inexplicable signings. Those other signings as unforgettable as they are incomprehensible

Trainer of the best-known streamers and businessman who wants to lead a "new boxing" in Spain that resembles the North American industry of this sport. Ambassador of the Athletic Club, three-time European champion and above all a charismatic icon who has attracted thousands of Generation Z kids to put on their gloves and go to the gym.

programme.title: 30 for 30: You Don't Know Bo
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

Africa's Wild Horizons: The Last Desert Giants (S2E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą, nuotykių. JAV, 2016. S2, Ep3
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV. Год: 2016. S2, Ep3 «Africa's Wild Horizons»…The Namib is the oldest desert in the world, hugging Africa's shoreline for over 400 kilometers. It is one of the most inhospitable habitats on earth. Yet the world's largest land mammal has made a home here, adapted through behavior and designed to life in the extremeAfrica's Wild Horizons is a documentary series that takes the viewers on a fantastic journey to Africa's lands, completely untouched by civilization. Feel its untamed wilderness, uncover mystical secrets, explore its one-of-a-kind flora and fauna, home to iconic animals and creatures of all possible kinds, where every day is an endless struggle for survival, and only the strongest stays alive. Take a look at Waterberg- a South African land formed before terrestrial life itself, the Vredefort Dome- a crater left after a giant meteorite crash, Swaziland's endless savanna, ecosystem of the Kalahari and the Okavango and much moreDirector: Werner Heffer

programme.title: Strange Creatures: Stinkers (S1E1). Documentary about nature. Canada, 2015. S1, Ep1

Nature never stops surprising us with its unique species and evolutionary unlike living things. Have a look at species with extraordinary survival skills, animals who camouflage in a skillful way for different reasons, creatures that convincingly play dead, find out if a grasshopper can vomit. These and much more amazing facts about animals are there for you in Strange CreaturesDirector: Chad Barclay

programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: Anglija, Naujoji Zelandija. Год: 2023. S3, Ep1 «Orangutan Jungle School»…Start a promising new term at the Orangutan Jungle School in Borneo. See newbie Bumi struggle to focus, track skittish Rumba's first timid steps toward independence, and cheer on star student Valentino as he experiences a bumpy start to collegeCaptivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. See newbie Bumi struggle to focus, track skittish Rumba's first timid steps toward independence, and cheer on star student Valentino as he experiences a bumpy start to collegeCaptivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. programme.title: d/f Belovezhskaya Pushcha
programme.desc: The first time you enter Belovezhskaya Pushcha as an ordinary park, the Master, the rightful owner. You breathe greedily in the resinous air until your head hurts, you break the rough tree bark, tear leaves, or even grind some small insect into dust. Just like that, out of half-childish inquisitiveness. It seems to you that all this is yours, it seems normal that man is always insatiable, and nature is always generous. But as soon as you step away from the beaten path, the first delights are replaced by slight fear: are you the master of all this thousand-year-old thicket? And you are already afraid of your loneliness, your insignificance, your weakness in front of the centuries-old pines, because a person has only the knowledge that civilization has given him, and the Pushcha has the memory of all the deeds of man. Director: Liliya Samoilova. Belarus

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S15 EP12
programme.desc: Khi mùa cá sấu bước vào tuần cuối cùng, Troy nỗ lực đào tạo thế hệ thợ săn Landry tiếp theo. Ronnie kêu gọi sự hiểu biết của Timmy về các lỗ mật bí mật để theo dõi số lượng thẻ của anh ấy.

programme.title: THE UNBELIEVABLE WITH DAN AYKROYD S1 EP07
programme.desc: Hãy tưởng tượng rơi tự do ở độ cao 30.000 feet mà không có dù, hoặc bị chôn sống và vẫn còn sống để kể lại câu chuyện. Hoặc... việc bị mắc kẹt trong một căn phòng nhỏ bên trong một con tàu bị chìm dưới đáy đại dương thì sao...

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S12 EP19

programme.title: SECRETS DECLASSIFIED WITH DAVID DUCHOVNY S1 EP10
programme.desc: Mặc dù đàn ông có thể giành chiến thắng trong các cuộc chiến nhưng chúng được chiến đấu bằng vũ khí. Lăn lộn giữa ngày tận thế và những hồ sơ được giải mật vô lý sẽ tiết lộ các chương trình vũ khí bí mật nhằm mục đích hủy diệt thế giới.

programme.title: MOUNTAIN MEN S13 EP07
